finale-of-the-deep:afterSkill.label: After her Skill
finale-of-the-deep:afterSkill.reason: Its ATK bonus lasts 15 seconds after her Elemental Skill and can start again every 10, so it is up while she casts her Skill when it is ready.

finale-of-the-deep:bond.label: Bond of Life cleared
finale-of-the-deep:bond.reason: It needs the Bond of Life the weapon gives her to be cleared by healing, which depends on the team.
